$comment: Immutable prior-release extension manifests, recovered with `git show <sourceCommit>:<sourcePath>`. Checked by TestPriorReleaseManifestsAreImmutable. The compatibility budget these prove is tooling/cli/doc/21-compatibility-and-migration.md.

fixtures.why: A real pre-registry manifest: it declares commands, so the contract ladder governs it, and it carries no `cliContract` member at all — which is what contract 0 looks like on disk. It is the last committed state of this manifest before the contract-3 cutover stamped it.

gaps.shape: a manifest stamped at cliContract 1 or 2
gaps.reason: The stamp is EARNED at package time and written into the packaged artifact, so no repository-committed manifest has ever carried 1 or 2. The lower-but-nonzero arm is covered synthetically by TestLoadManifest_CompatibilityMatrix, which renders every ladder rung against every surface kind.
